experiment.claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's ratified "PSRR" row (>50dB @ 1kHz and >20dB @ 100kHz, at 1mA (light-load, binding) and at 50mA) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch). The row is ratified by issue #1 / DR-006, and the four bounds below cite it verbatim. As of #117 this deck measures all FOUR conditions the row names -- both frequencies at BOTH load points. The v1 deck measured only the ~1mA point because the pre-#25 five-transistor amplifier had no valid regulating DC operating point at 50mA to linearize around; #25's current-mirror-OTA rebuild removed that ceiling, and the 50mA point now regulates (VOUT = 1.798V at tt/27C/3.30V), so the row's 50mA half is no longer un-testbenched. Both load points are swept inside one deck (the 1.8kOhm schematic load, then 'alter rload = 36'), the same single-deck/multi-point pattern sim/loop-gain uses. As of #179 both points are seeded per sim/README.md's initial-condition contract (#171): the testbench carries a .nodeset card seeding the three branch-defining nodes (VOUT=1.8, FB=1.2, N_FBB=0.6), which ngspice applies to EVERY operating-point solve in the deck -- including the one each `ac` performs for itself -- so neither the 1mA point nor the `alter`-reached 50mA point linearizes around an unconstrained Newton solve. `.ic` would not have done this: ngspice honours `.ic` only for the transient operating point, so it is inert in an ac-only deck. Only the branch-defining nodes are seeded: a .nodeset card is a single static card applied to both load points, and the eleven-node seed from sim/ic-screen-125c-b (its 125C/50mA values) was measured to drag ss/-40C/3.63V's 1mA point onto a non-regulating branch (VOUT=3.633V=VIN), reporting 0.017dB of PSRR there instead of 25.7dB -- see sim/README.md's "#179". The seed does NOT clear #171's solver-diagnostic FAIL gate; the residue is recorded as a finding there, not suppressed.
